beats.say: One massive track has over five billion streams on Spotify.
At number ten is Stay, followed by Perfect, and Someone You Loved.
Sunflower takes seventh, One Dance is sixth, and Harry Styles track As It Was hits fifth.
Starboy sits firmly in fourth place with massive global numbers.
Sweater Weather is third, Shape Of You is second, and Blinding Lights takes the crown.
The Weeknd leads the pack, and that is why...

facts: Blinding Lights by The Weeknd is ranked number 1 with 5.646 billion streams.
Shape Of You by Ed Sheeran is ranked number 2 with 5.154 billion streams.
Sweater Weather by The Neighbourhood is ranked number 3 with 4.973 billion streams.
Starboy by The Weeknd and Daft Punk is ranked number 4 with 4.826 billion streams.
As It Was by Harry Styles is ranked number 5 with 4.682 billion streams.
One Dance by Drake, Wizkid, and Kyla is ranked number 6 with 4.529 billion streams.
Sunflower by Post Malone and Swae Lee is ranked number 7 with 4.524 billion streams.
Someone You Loved by Lewis Capaldi is ranked number 8 with 4.475 billion streams.
Perfect by Ed Sheeran is ranked number 9 with 4.157 billion streams.
Stay by The Kid Laroi and Justin Bieber is ranked number 10 with 4.114 billion streams.
